items.title: ABAC DENY policies support AI securables and attachment to individual objects (Beta)
items.text: Expanded FOR clause support: DENY policies can now apply to model services, model provider services, MCP services, agent services, and skills. Expanded ON clause support: DENY policies can now be attached directly on tables, volumes, functions, models, secrets, model services, model provider services, MCP services, agent services, and skills. See Supported securable types and privileges.

items.title: Partial schema inference for Python Lakeflow pipelines
items.text: In an upcoming release, Python Lakeflow pipelines will support partial schema inference in Beta. You will be able to use the override_schema argument of table, materialized_view, or create_streaming_table to declare only the columns whose type, constraint, or comment you want to control. The pipeline infers the remaining columns from the query output. See Develop pipeline code with Python.

items.title: AI Functions Asynchronous API (Beta)
items.text: You can now use the AI Functions Asynchronous API to run ai_parse_document, ai_extract, or ai_classify asynchronously on up to 50,000 requests from a JSONL file in a Unity Catalog volume. The batch writes one result for each request to a file in a volume. Workspace admins can turn on the AI Functions Asynchronous API preview from the Previews page. This feature is in Beta. See the Asynchronous API reference. For examples, see document parsing, information extraction, and classification.
